title: Prove a single three-cycle costs six with arbitrary address spectators
body:
One coordinate three-cycle now costs exactly **six coordinate-CNOT calls** in `M_R(F2[GL_n(F2)])` for every finite `n≥3` and `R≥1`, with arbitrary free scalar mixing and every extra dirty register/address coordinate restored. This closes the single-three-cycle all-dimension boundary of [PR4968](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4968), whose three-cycle calculation covers `n=3,R≤2`.

The proof expands the full group-algebra word: a nonzero target coefficient must occur as a subword of the paid address labels. In a hypothetical address word of at most five calls, the three changed rows each need a write and each written/restored spectator needs two. Thus at most one spectator is written. Restriction to the invariant subspace of all never-written coordinates reduces the question to four address coordinates. A complete finite exclusion then rules out five calls; two swaps attain six.

This is a **computer-assisted uniform theorem**, with written support/write-budget/restriction arguments and an explicit finite premise. It does not use natural-image equality to accept a formal identity or assume clean original inputs. It does not claim multi-three-cycle additivity, the exact regular-cut relaxation optimum, a native supplier, or a new κ.

The package is `research/three-cycle-address-floor/`. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1317#discussioncomment-19138311).

Validation completed locally:

- All 12 GL4 coordinate CNOTs; exact layers `1,12,96,542`, balls of sizes 109 and 651; 651 primary split joins with zero five-call hits.
- Separate truth-table engine, importing no primary code: all 16 inputs on all 651 states (10,416 checks), complete state-set agreement, and 1,308 middle-edge bridges with zero hits. Both engines have positive short-target controls.
- Full formal six-call witnesses at `(n,R)=(3,1),(4,3),(8,5)`, dense scalar-frame restoration, inverse-cycle distinction, arbitrary mixing/subword support, omitted-call, illegal-label and unreturned-spectator controls, and a nonzero formal natural-image alias.
- Six actual isolated optimized-CLI source/receipt corruptions rejected; registered Python 3.12 normal replay and direct `-I -O -B` replay passed.
- Nine committed files and source-history preflight passed at `538ccab19e01012ecd67a79d5a0a6341a9ebe933`. Official export/check passed. All three scripts passed from the extracted Git-free export with `-I -O -B` and `PATH=/nonexistent`. Export SHA-256: `2a965f3e78cea1588bfc25bc7cd4e360f6e0c0067086705cd341ac611fb1c257`.
- Selected baseline bindings passed; this is not a selected-construction cold replay. No C++, Lean, Docker, predecessor census or hosted-CI result is asserted.

Two commits separate the proof/reduction (`af2188648c7a8adaa34550f7f098c1946696b685`) from the exact engines, controls and reproducibility package (`538ccab19e01012ecd67a79d5a0a6341a9ebe933`). Both author and committer are JoyboyBrian. A separate coordinating Codex review read the complete proof and both engines and found no blocker; all work is substantially OpenAI Codex assisted, with no independent human or formal-kernel acceptance claimed.

Credit James Reed #4968/#4950, Mihir Srivastava #4939 for the spectator/write-budget model, commdata2338 #1414/#1495, Ross Richardson #1989, Gareth Davidson #1333, PR1541 and their retained predecessors. No predecessor files are edited or imported as runtime dependencies. Scientific base: `b91956876e5b4122fd89179f1b57557ff8378f15`, priority revision 7, selected κ `60403/20000000` unchanged.

Entry overlap covered 317 open PRs, 4,064 Discussion records and 6,636 local notes, complete pagination/inventory. Card and exact three-cycle queries plus live PR4968 and canonical #1317 reads found the finite predecessor and other-model cycles, not this all-dimension single-target theorem. Cached snapshots, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain limits; no novelty guarantee is made.

Final submission overlap used the complete refreshed cache: 318 open PRs fetched 2026-10-23 04:59:29 UTC, 4,077 Discussion records fetched 05:00:22 UTC, and 6,638 committed local notes (including this package). The broad cycle query returned 79 leads; scoped matches remain the immediate predecessor, this claim, and fixed-dimensional or different-alphabet findings. This also identifies Josie Elliston's earlier [PR1974](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1974), `research/bit-gl3-mixed-targets-length10/`: its GL3 two-register all-pairs result and bounded third-register probe retain their credit. Those fixed-address calculations are not rerun, replaced or claimed as new; this theorem's contribution is uniform address and register dimensions through the support/restriction reduction. Live #4968/#4950/#4939 heads were rechecked unchanged. Root's final canonical fetch remained `b91956876e5b4122fd89179f1b57557ff8378f15`; no source/guidance change required replay. Snapshot limitations remain as above.
